record.paper_title: Several Open Problems in Operator Theory
record.original_question: If, for a fixed a in [0, 2), there exists a two-dimensional Banach space E_star with epsilon_0(E_star) = a whose modulus of convexity dominates the modulus of every other two-dimensional Banach space E with epsilon_0(E) = a, is such an extremal space unique in some appropriate sense?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E$ be a real two-dimensional Banach space with unit ball $B_E$ and unit sphere $S_E$. The modulus of convexity of $E$ is the function $\delta_E:[0,2]\to[0,1]$ defined by
$$\delta_E(\varepsilon)=\inf\Bigl\{1-\tfrac{\|x+y\|}{2}:\ x,y\in S_E,\ \|x-y\|\ge \varepsilon\Bigr\},$$
and one sets
$$\varepsilon_0(E)=\sup\{\varepsilon\in[0,2]:\delta_E(\varepsilon)=0\}.$$
Fix $a\in[0,2)$ and suppose there exists a two-dimensional Banach space $E_*$ with $\varepsilon_0(E_*)=a$ such that for every two-dimensional Banach space $E$ with $\varepsilon_0(E)=a$ one has
$$\delta_E(\varepsilon)\le \delta_{E_*}(\varepsilon)\quad\text{for all }\varepsilon\in[0,2].$$
Question: Is such an extremal space $E_*$ unique up to isometric isomorphism (or, more generally, in any natural sense, e.g. up to equivalence of moduli)?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not turn up a published resolution of this uniqueness question for the extremal two-dimensional Banach space with prescribed $\varepsilon_0$. The literature characterizes which functions can be moduli of convexity of two-dimensional spaces and studies extremal properties, but no source verifying uniqueness (or non-uniqueness) of such an extremal space was located, so the status is unclear.

status_evidence.title: Modulus of convexity in Banach spaces - ScienceDirect
status_evidence.snippet: Functions which can be modulus of convexity of some two-dimensional normed space have been characterized up to equivalence through direct geometrical construction of the unit sphere.
status_evidence.claim: Characterizations of moduli of convexity of two-dimensional spaces exist, but uniqueness of an extremal space at a given $\varepsilon_0$ is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: On the moduli of convexity
status_evidence.snippet: Studies moduli of convexity and their extremal behavior.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit resolution of the uniqueness of the extremal two-dimensional space is reported.
